relations.subject: Cheng Yen
relations.evidence: In February 1963, she became the disciple of her mentor, Yin Shun, who gave her the dharma name of Cheng Yen and the courtesy name of Huìzhāng

relations.subject: Cheng Yen
relations.object: Buddhist Compassion Relief Tzu Chi Foundation
relations.evidence: Cheng Yen established the Buddhist Compassion Relief Tzu Chi Foundation on 14 May 1966 in an endeavor to help the poor of east Taiwan.
